Load data
```{r}
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")
counts = read.csv("../input/Bulk_counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1)
coldata = read.csv("../input/Bulk_clinical_raw.csv", row.names = 1)
df_density = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_density.csv", row.names = 1)
df_entropy = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv", row.names = 1)
```

Subset to RNAseq and spatial (60 patients overlap)
```{r}
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density)%in%colnames(counts),]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy)%in%colnames(counts),]
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(df_density)]
coldata = coldata[rownames(coldata)%in% colnames(counts),]

df_density = df_density[match(colnames(counts), rownames(df_density)),]
df_entropy = df_entropy[match(colnames(counts), rownames(df_entropy)),]

all.equal(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
all.equal(colnames(counts), rownames(df_density))
all.equal(colnames(counts), rownames(df_entropy))

data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(df) {
  df <- df[rownames(df) %in% rownames(coldata), ]
  df = data.frame(df[rownames(coldata),]) #Order samples 
  return(df)
})

all.equal(colnames(counts), rownames(data_spatial$Stroma))
```

Normalize counts (60 patients)
```{r}
counts.TPM.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
counts.norm.log = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

DCs-markers expression vs cell densities (60 patients)
```{r}
dc_subtypes = c("cDC1_plus", "cDC2_plus", "Mature_DC_plus", "pDC_plus")
data_spatial = do.call(cbind, data_spatial)

# Create gene set list
gene_sets <- list(
  Signature_cDC1_plus = c("CLNK", "XCR1", "WDFY4", "CLEC9A", "DNASE1L3"),
  Signature_cDC2_plus = c("CLEC10A", "CD1C", "FCER1A"),
  Signature_Mature_DC_plus = c("LAMP3", "BIRC3", "CCR7"),
  Signature_pDC_plus = c("CLEC4C",  "LILRA4", "PACSIN1", "SPIB")
)

markers_all = unlist(unname(gene_sets))

# Calulate DCs signature scores
dc_signatures_score = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, gene_sets = gene_sets, 
                                               paths = pathways_universe, file.name = "DC_signatures")[[2]]

## DC signatures - DC densities
compute.modules.relationship(dc_signatures_score, data_spatial[,grep(paste0(paste0("Total.", dc_subtypes), collapse = "|"), 
                                                                     colnames(data_spatial)), drop = F], 
                             file_name = "DC_signatures-densities", width = 8, height = 7, ncol.grid = 3)

## Markers expression - DC densities
compute.modules.relationship(data_spatial[,grep(paste0(paste0("Total.", dc_subtypes), collapse = "|"), 
                                                colnames(data_spatial)), drop = F], 
                             t(counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%markers_all,]),
                             file_name = "DC_markers-densities", width = 10, height = 7, width.grid = 20, height.grid = 15)

## DC signatures from RNAseq across response
compute.metadata.association(dc_signatures_score, coldata[,"R.NR",drop=F], file.name = "DC_signatures_Response", width = 8, height = 15, pval = 1, y_min = -2, y_max = 2, width_grid = 12, height_grid = 5)
```

Analysis across patient clusters 
```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

Add patient groups obtained from megaclusters densities (58 patients) --> Remember there were 2 outliers
```{r}
load("../output/Patients_groups.RData")
patient_groups = patient_groups[rownames(patient_groups)%in%rownames(coldata),]
coldata = coldata[rownames(coldata)%in%rownames(patient_groups),]
patient_groups = patient_groups[rownames(coldata),]
all.equal(rownames(patient_groups), rownames(coldata)) ## Rownames of coldata and patient_groups are in AN
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = factor(ifelse(patient_groups$Groups == 4, 3, patient_groups$Groups))) ## Rename group 
table(coldata$Groups)
```

Match patients in groups from spatial with RNAseq bulk (58 patients)
```{r}
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(coldata)]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy)%in%rownames(coldata),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density)%in%rownames(coldata),]
```

Normalize counts (58 patients)
```{r}
counts.TPM.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
counts.norm.log = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

TF analysis (58 patients)
```{r}
tfs = compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log, file.name = "NSCLC_Late_stage", universe = tfs_universe)

#network = compute.WTCNA(tfs, corr_mod = 0.8, clustering.method = "ward.D2", return = T) 
#### Create TF network (TFs modules were already saved - no need to run again)
tfs_modules = read.csv("../output/TFs_modules.csv")

tfs_list <- setNames(
  strsplit(tfs_modules$Composition, ","),
  tfs_modules$TFs.module
)

tf_to_color <- unlist(lapply(names(tfs_list), function(color) {
  setNames(rep(color, length(tfs_list[[color]])), trimws(tfs_list[[color]]))
}))

tf_colors <- unname(tf_to_color[colnames(tfs)])

MEList = WGCNA::moduleEigengenes(tfs, colors = tf_colors, scale = F)
MEs = MEList$eigengenes
MEs = WGCNA::orderMEs(MEs)
colnames(MEs) <- gsub("ME", "", colnames(MEs))

network = list()
network[["TFs module matrix"]] = MEs
network[["TFs colors"]] = tf_colors
network[["TFs per module"]] = tf_to_color

#### TF modules - patient clusters
compute.metadata.association(network[[1]], coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 0.05, file.name = "TF_modules_Groups", y_min = -0.2, y_max = -0.05, width_grid = 6, height_grid = 5)

#### TF modules - megaclusters density and entropy
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], df_entropy, "Entropy-TFs_Modules", width = 8)
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], df_density, "Density-TFs_Modules", width = 8)
```

Pathway analysis (58 patients)
```{r}
pathways = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, paths = pathways_universe, file.name = "NSCLC_Late_stage")
#TF modules - pathways
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], pathways, "Pathways_Progeny-TFs_Modules", width = 10, width.grid = 20, height.grid = 15)
```

Chemokines scores (58 patients)
```{r}
chemokines = c("CCL1", "CCL11", "CCL13", "CCL16", "CCL17", "CCL19", "CCL2", "CCL20", "CCL21", "CCL22", "CCL23", "CCL24","CCL25", 
               "CCL26", "CCL27", "CCL4", "CCL7", "CCL8", "CX3CL1", "CXCL1","CXCL11", "CXCL12", "CXCL16", "CXCL3", "CXCL5", "CXCL6", 
               "PPBP", "XCL1", "XCL2", "ACKR4", "CCR1", "CCR10", "CCR2", "CCR3", "CCR4", "CCR6", "CCR7", "CCR8", "CCR9",
               "CMKLR1", "CXCR1", "CXCR3", "CXCR4", "CXCR6", "DARC", "XCR1")

geneset = list(chemokines)

chemokines_score = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, paths = pathways_universe, 
                                            gene_sets = geneset, file.name = "Chemokines_signature")[[2]]
colnames(chemokines_score)[[1]] = "chemokines_score"

counts.norm.chemokines = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%chemokines,]

#### Chemokines - megaclusters density and entropy
compute.modules.relationship(t(counts.norm.chemokines), df_entropy, "Entropy-Chemokines", width = 8, height = 15, width.grid = 25, height.grid = 20)
compute.modules.relationship(t(counts.norm.chemokines), df_density, "Density-Chemokines", width = 8, height = 15, width.grid = 25, height.grid = 20)

#### Chemokines signatures - Patient groups
compute.metadata.association(chemokines_score, coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 1, file.name = "Chemokines_signature_Groups",
                              y_min = -2, y_max = 2, width_grid = 8, height_grid = 5)

#### Chemokines - Patient groups
compute.metadata.association(t(counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%chemokines,]), 
                             coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 0.05, file.name = "Chemokines_Groups",
                              y_min = -1, y_max = 9, width_grid = 18, height_grid = 10)
```

Interferon genes (58 patients)
```{r}
# Type I interferons (alpha and beta)
IFN_I <- c("IFNA1", "IFNA2", "IFNA4", "IFNA5", "IFNA6", "IFNA7", "IFNA8",
           "IFNA10", "IFNA13", "IFNA14", "IFNA16", "IFNA17", "IFNA21", "IFNB1")

# Type II interferon (gamma)
IFN_II <- c("IFNG")

# Type III interferons (lambda)
IFN_III <- c("IFNL1", "IFNL2", "IFNL3", "IFNL4")

compute.metadata.association(t(counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%c(IFN_I, IFN_II, IFN_III),]), 
                             coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 0.05, file.name = "Interferons_groups",
                             y_min = 0, y_max = 4, width_grid = 10, height_grid = 8, ncol = 3)
```

Immunoscores (58 patients)
```{r}
source("src/immunoscores.R")
immunescores = compute_gold_standards(counts.norm.log)

#### Immunescores - patient clusters
compute.metadata.association(immunescores, coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], file.name = "Immunescores_Groups", pval = 1,
```

Cell type deconvolution (58 patients)
```{r}
#Filter to only patients within clusters
deconv = deconv[rownames(deconv)%in%rownames(coldata),]

# Filter to only LM22 signature
deconv_cbsx_lm22 = deconv[,grep("CBSX_LM22", colnames(deconv))] 

### Deconvolution - Patients groups
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = ifelse(Groups == 1, "DC_scattered", ifelse(Groups == 2, "cDC1_driven", "cDC2_driven")))
compute.metadata.association(deconv_cbsx_lm22 %>% dplyr::select(-CBSX_LM22_B.naive.cells, -CBSX_LM22_CD4.naive), coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 2, file.name = "Deconvolution_Groups",
                             y_min = 0, y_max = 0.3, width_grid = 20, height_grid = 15)

### Deconvolution - Megaclusters density
compute.modules.relationship(deconv_cbsx_lm22, df_density, "Density-Deconv_LM22", width = 8, height = 12, width.grid = 35, height.grid = 22, ncol.grid = 5)

### Deconvolution - Megaclusters entropy
compute.modules.relationship(deconv_cbsx_lm22, df_entropy, "Entropy-Deconv_LM22", width = 8, height = 12, width.grid = 20, height.grid = 10)
```

Scatter plot: Gamma delta
```{r}
all.equal(rownames(deconv_cbsx_lm22), rownames(df_density))
df = cbind("T.cells.gamma.delta" = deconv_cbsx_lm22$CBSX_LM22_T.cells.gamma.delta, 
           "Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC" = df_density$Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC)

stats::cor(deconv_cbsx_lm22$CBSX_LM22_T.cells.gamma.delta, df_density$Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC, use = "all.obs", "pearson")

ggplot(df, aes(x = Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC, y = T.cells.gamma.delta)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(
    method = "spearman",
    label.x.npc = "left",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

Differential active TFs across patient groups (58 patients)
```{r}
coldata$group_1 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 1, 1, "rest"))
res_1 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_1, "1", "rest", file.name = "Diff_1vsrest", 
                      TF.collection = "ARACNE", aracne_path = "../output/TF_network_ARACNE.txt")

coldata$group_2 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 2, 2, "rest"))
res_2 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_2, "2", "rest", file.name = "Diff_2vsrest", 
                      TF.collection = "ARACNE", aracne_path = "../output/TF_network_ARACNE.txt")

coldata$group_3 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 3, 3, "rest"))
res_3 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_3, "3", "rest", file.name = "Diff_3vsrest", 
                      TF.collection = "ARACNE", aracne_path = "../output/TF_network_ARACNE.txt")

gene_sets <- list(
  Group1_markers = res_1$TFs_UP,
  Group2_markers = res_2$TFs_UP,
  Group3_markers = res_3$TFs_UP
)
```

TFs signatures scores (58 patients)
```{r}
tfs = scale(compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log, TF.collection = "ARACNE", file.name = "NSCLC_Late_stage_ARACNE"))
deg_signatures_score = compute.pathway.activity(t(tfs), paths = pathways_universe, gene_sets = gene_sets, file.name = "TF_signatures")[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(deg_signatures_score, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
coldata$deg_group = patient_group
```

Survival analysis (58 patients)
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(coldata, "PFS", "PFS_event", file_name = "Patient_groups", p.value = 0.05, group_column = "deg_group")
```
